added_lines: night prayer: o lord, as we end this day, we turn to you and ask for your peace. cal m our minds, quiet our hearts and give rest to our bodies. forgive any wrongs we have done a nd help us forgive those who have wronged us. watch over us tonight, shield us from harm and hold us in your everlasting love. amen the november offerings (all souls offerings) offerings for the masses for the dead can be handed in at any of the masses next weekend the catholic church has along tradition of praying for the dead. the personal experience of the saints shows us the masses offered and our prayer sacrifices and penances are most effective in increasing the peace and joy of those in heave n and helping those on the journey to the father’s house. masses will be said for the deceased throughout the year. may all our deceased relatives and friends rest in peace. cloyne
